'''Dai Lixin''' ({{zh|c=戴立信|p=Dài Lìxìn}}; 13 November 1924 – 13 May 2024) was a Chinese chemist, and an academic of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].

== Biography ==
Dai was born in [[Beijing]] on 13 November 1924 and was raised at his [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] is in [[Jurong, Jiangsu]].<ref name="ra">{{cite news  |url=https://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2024/5/522607.shtm |script-title=zh:著名有机化学家戴立信院士逝世 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=14 May 2024 |access-date=15 May 2024 |language=zh}}</ref><ref name="rg">{{cite news |author1=Hou Qian ({{lang|zh|侯茜}}) |url=https://www.cas.cn/cm/201611/t20161114_4581254.shtml |script-title=zh:【中国科学报】化学担当——记著名有机化学家戴立信院士 |work=cas.cn |date=14 November 2016 |access-date=15 May 2024 |language=zh}}</ref> In 1936, when he studied at Yuying Middle School, the [[Second Sino-Japanese War]] broke out, and his family fled to their grandfather's house in the [[Shanghai French Concession]].<ref name="rg"/> After graduating from Sanyu High School, he was accepted to the Department of Chemistry at [[Hujiang University]] in 1942.<ref name="rg"/> A year later, he transferred to the Department of Chemistry at [[Zhejiang University]].<ref name="ra"/><ref name="rg"/>

After graduating from university in 1947, Dai taught at Shanghai Zhonghua Vocational School for a short time.<ref name="rg"/> In 1948, he was introduced by his classmates to work in the laboratory of the 3rd Iron and Steel Plant located in [[Pudong]].<ref name="rg"/> He joined the [[Chinese Communist Party]] (CCP) in 1949.<ref name="ra"/>

After the establishment of the Communist State in 1949, Dai successively worked at Shanghai Iron and Steel Company and East China Mining and Metallurgy Bureau.<ref name="rg"/> In 1953, he was transferred to the Shanghai Institute of Organic Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and in 1958, he was engaged in scientific and technological organization related to [[organic chemistry]] in the "[[Two Bombs, One Satellite]]" project.<ref name="ra"/><ref name="rb"/><ref name="rg"/> In 1962, he independently carried out extensive work on [[borohydride]] reactions and chemical research on [[carborane]]s.<ref name="rb"/><ref name="rg"/> During the ten-year [[Cultural Revolution]], he was forced to perform hard labor instead of doing research in the laboratory.<ref name="rc">{{cite news |author1=Tianlin Subdistrict ({{lang|zh|田林街道}}) |url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_12109331 |script-title=zh:迎接建党百年——有机化学专家戴立信院士的“合成之美” |work=thepaper |date=8 April 2021 |access-date=15 May 2024 |quote={{lang|zh|“里通外国”的帽子压下来会压死人的。当时的戴立信还关在“牛棚”里，写检查，遭批斗，家都回不得，和家人硬生生拆散！}} |language=zh}}</ref> He was a victim of [[political persecution]] that affected other academics at the time.<ref name="rc"/> In 1978, he returned to his research position and served as an assistant to [[Wang You]], director of the Shanghai Institute of Organic Chemistry at that time.<ref name="rg"/> He was promoted to doctoral supervisor in June 1986.<ref name="rg"/> In the 1990s, he and academician [[Huang Liang (chemist)|Huang Liang]] jointly led the major project of the Ninth Five Year Plan - "Chemical and Biological Research of Chiral Drugs".<ref name="rb"/>

On 13 May 2024, Dai died in [[Shanghai]], at the age of 99.<ref name="ra"/>

== Family ==
Dai married Dong Zhuxin ({{zh|s=董竹心|labels=no}}) and had a daughter Dai Jing ({{zh|s=戴敬|labels=no}}).<ref name="rg"/>

== Honours and awards ==
* 1993 - Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref name="ra"/><ref name="rb"/>
* 2002 - Science and Technology Progress Award of the [[Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation]]<ref name="rb" />
* 2013 - State Natural Science Award (Second Class) for asymmetric catalysis based on chiral phosphine nitrogen ligands.<ref name="rb" />
* 2018 - Lifetime Achievement Award of the [[Chinese Chemical Society (Beijing)|Chinese Chemical Society]]<ref name="rb">{{cite news |author1=Wen Congling ({{lang|zh|文聪玲}}) |url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_2120411 |script-title=zh:中科院上海有机化学所院士戴立信获中国化学会首个终身成就奖 |work=thepaper |date=9 May 2018 |access-date=15 May 2024 |language=zh}}</ref>
